questions.question: On January 1, 2025, were there more children transferred out of CBP custody than children apprehended and placed in CBP custody?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('hhs_unaccompanied_children_program.csv')
row = df[df['Date'] == 'January 01 2025'].iloc[0]
transferred = row['Children transferred out of CBP custody']
apprehended = row['Children apprehended and placed in CBP custody*']
result = 'yes' if transferred > apprehended else 'no'

questions.question: On what date in August 2021 was the highest number of children discharged from HHS care?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('hhs_unaccompanied_children_program.csv')
aug_2021 = df[df['Date'].str.contains('August') & df['Date'].str.contains('2021')].copy()
max_row = aug_2021.loc[aug_2021['Children discharged from HHS Care'].idxmax()]
result = pd.to_datetime(max_row['Date']).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

questions.question: In December 2024, on how many reporting dates did the number of children apprehended and placed in CBP custody exceed 200?
